config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.title: Auto Tool Switch
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.categ: Choose when automatic switching is allowed and configure its shortcuts.
Control how the best eligible tool is ranked for the targeted block.
Protect worn tools and choose the tool types and hotbar slots that may be selected.
Use exact identifiers or #tags to include or exclude blocks and tools.
Choose what happens when mining ends and which status messages are shown.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.enabl: Master switch for automatic tool selection.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.activ: The activation/bypass key can be ignored, required, or used as a temporary pause.
Used according to Activation behavior. Left Alt is the default bypass key.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.toggl: Toggles and saves the master switch. Unbound by default.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.allow: When disabled, sneaking prevents an automatic switch.
Creative mode usually does not benefit from a mining tool.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.pause: Do not switch while eating, drawing a bow, blocking, or otherwise using an item.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.corre: Prefer or require tools that can harvest drops which need a correct tool.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.minim: Items slower than this are ignored. 1.01 excludes ordinary hand-speed items.
Avoid switching unless the candidate is this much faster. Correct-tool and strong enchantment preferences can override it.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.loot_: Select no loot preference, Silk Touch, Fortune, or a tool without enchantments.
Use the preference only for speed ties, rank it before speed, or reject nonmatching tools.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.durab: When tools mine equally fast, choose by remaining durability or hotbar order.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.remai: Never select a damageable tool with fewer points remaining. Set 2 to avoid the final breaking hit.
Never select a tool below this remaining percentage. Both durability limits must pass.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.rules: Enter namespaced IDs such as minecraft:stone or tags such as #minecraft:logs. A whitelist with no entries intentionally matches nothing.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.retur: Keep the selected tool or return to the slot held before automatic switching began.
Wait this many ticks after attack is released before returning.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.cance: Cancel the pending return when you select a different hotbar slot yourself.
config.inventory_toolkit.auto_tool.show_: Show the chosen tool above the hotbar.
Show whether the module was enabled or disabled with its toggle key.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.ena: Master switch for quick stacking into the open container and nearby containers.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.sho: Show a quick stack button in the top-right corner of supported container screens.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.key: In the world or the inventory screen: quick stack into every container within reach (press again to cancel). In a container screen: quick stack into that container. Unbound by default.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.inc: Also deposit matching hotbar stacks. The main inventory is always included.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.mat: Only deposit stacks whose components (enchantments, names, potion types) match an item in the container.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.inc: Also deposit tools, armor, potions, and other items that cannot stack.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.sho: Show progress and a summary above the hotbar while and after quick stacking, sorting, or scanning. Messages explaining why an action could not start are always shown.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.nea: Pressing the key outside a screen opens each chest, barrel, and shulker box within reach, deposits matching items, and closes it again. Their screens are never shown.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.sho: Show a button in the top-right corner of the inventory screen that quick stacks to nearby containers.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.req: Skip containers you cannot see directly. Disabling this also reaches containers behind blocks, which some servers reject or flag.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.con: Ticks to wait after closing one container before opening the next. Raise this on servers that limit how quickly containers may be opened.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.mem: Record what is inside every chest, barrel, and shulker box you open, quick stack into, or scan, per world or server. Required for searching.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.sea: Opens the container search in the world or from the inventory screen. Unbound by default.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.sho: Show a ? button next to the quick stack button in the inventory screen.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.alt: Alt+left-click an item in any inventory or container screen to outline every remembered container holding that item.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.hig: How long containers stay outlined after picking a search result.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.sea: Search results also list items you could craft from what your inventory and remembered containers hold, with how many. Picking one outlines the containers to take the ingredients from. Uses the game's own recipes, so data-pack recipes on a server may be missing.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.sor: Sorting opens every container within reach, gives each one a category, and moves items between them through your empty inventory slots. Vanilla items are grouped into categories including building, decoration, nature, lighting, transport, and utility. Name a chest after a category (for example "Redstone" or "Mob Drops") to choose its category yourself. Items from other mods that fit no category stay where they are and are recorded below for review.
Enabled
Allow sorting nearby chests with the sort key or the inventory button. Uses the line of sight and delay settings of Nearby Containers.
Sort key
In the world or the inventory screen: sort every container within reach (press again to cancel). Unbound by default.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.sho: Show a sort button in the top-right corner of the inventory screen.
config.inventory_toolkit.quick_stack.sor: Preview before sorting
The first press of the sort key or button only labels each nearby chest with the category it would get. Press again within 20 seconds to sort. Turn off to sort straight away.
Put away your inventory

Also move your own items into the container of their category, even when it does not hold them yet. Follows the Include hotbar and Include unstackable items settings in General, so the hotbar and tools stay with you by default.
Use container names
A container renamed in an anvil to a category name, such as "Wood", "Farm", or "Gear", always gets that category.
Include placed shulker boxes
Also sort into and out of shulker boxes placed within reach. Chests and barrels are always included.
Sort backpack contents
With Traveler's Backpack installed, also puts the items in your worn backpack (or else the first backpack in your inventory) into the nearby chest of their category, when that chest has room.
Custom categories

One rule per line as item_id=category, for example minecraft:diamond=equipment. Categories: wood, stone, redstone, mob_drops, farming, nature, building, decoration, lighting, transport, utility, nether, end, equipment, valuables, miscellaneous, or none to never move the item.
Use item_id=category with a known item and category
Items seen without a category

Item registry IDs found in nearby containers, your inventory, or your backpack during sorting or preview. Add an item_id=category rule above to sort one; remove entries here to clear the review list. Explicit rules ending in =none are not recorded.
config.inventory_toolkit.compact.title: Compact
config.inventory_toolkit.compact.enabled: Show the compact button in the top-right corner of the crafting table screen.
config.inventory_toolkit.compact.only_re: Only compact into blocks that can be crafted back into the nine items, such as iron or coal blocks. Melons, nether wart blocks, and packed ice are skipped.
config.inventory_toolkit.compact.show_me: Show what was crafted above the hotbar.
config.inventory_toolkit.compact.exclude: Item IDs to leave alone, for example minecraft:wheat or minecraft:redstone. Matches either the material or the block.

%s is protected (%s) and was not dropped
message.inventory_toolkit.inventory_sort: Sorting stopped because the inventory changed. Try again.
Press the Inventory Sort key (middle mouse button by default) in an inventory screen. Over a chest, barrel, shulker box, dispenser, or hopper slot, or a slot of another mod's storage screen such as a backpack, it sorts that container; over your main inventory, or anywhere on the panel while only your inventory is open, it sorts your inventory; over the hotbar it sorts the hotbar. Locked slots stay where they are.
The order used when no modifier key is held.
The order used while Shift is held.
The order used while Ctrl is held.
The order used while Alt is held.

Sorted separately: sorting over the hotbar sorts only the hotbar, and the main inventory never moves items into it. With the inventory: the hotbar is sorted together with the main inventory. Never: the hotbar is left alone.
config.inventory_toolkit.slot_lock.title: Slot Lock
config.inventory_toolkit.slot_lock.help: Hover over a slot in any inventory screen and press %s to lock or unlock it. Locked slots show a padlock. %s slots are locked.
config.inventory_toolkit.slot_lock.enabl: Protect locked slots. Turning this off keeps your locks for later.
config.inventory_toolkit.slot_lock.block: Ignore shift-clicks on a locked slot, including Shift+double-click "move all". A normal click still picks the item up.
config.inventory_toolkit.slot_lock.show_: Also show the padlock on locked hotbar slots outside inventory screens.
config.inventory_toolkit.slot_lock.unloc: Removes all locks when you save.
config.inventory_toolkit.drop_protection: Check drops with the drop key, in the world or over a slot, and drops made by clicking outside an inventory screen. Inventory Sweeper never drops protected items either.
When a protected item is dropped
Ask to confirm: the drop goes through if you repeat it within 3 seconds. Block: protected items are never dropped.
Protect enchanted items and enchanted books.
Protect items renamed in an anvil.
Protect shulker boxes, bundles, and other container items that hold items.
Protect anything in a slot locked with Slot Lock.
Protect items of this rarity and above, shown by the color of their name. Uncommon (yellow) includes totems, heads, and smithing templates.
Item IDs to protect as well, for example minecraft:diamond or minecraft:netherite_ingot.
config.inventory_toolkit.shulker_preview: Show a grid of the stored items in the tooltip of shulker boxes and other container items.
Show the grid only while Shift is held. Otherwise the tooltip shows the vanilla item list and a hint.
Leave out the vanilla text list of stored items while the grid is shown.
Tint the grid with the shulker box's dye color.
